results.title: What Kidal Portends: JNIM, Islamic State, and the Sahelian Security Landscape - The Soufan Center
results.snippet:
The retaking of Mali’s northern desert town of Kidal from Tuareg separatists and al-Qaeda-linked Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) represents a moderate gain for the Malian government, but one with limited strategic value.
 Sustained operations by JNIM in both Mali and Burkina Faso aim not at territorial control but at waging a war of attrition against the juntas.
